locale_lang.description: BCP-47 code of the language these messages are written in. Set it to your locale's code (for example fr or pt-BR). Pages use it for their lang attribute and plural rules.

ext_name.description: Extension name in Chrome and the Web Store. A product name; usually not translated.

ext_description.message: Learn languages through the English you already read: contextual words, hover hints and click-to-English.
ext_description.description: Extension description in Chrome and the Web Store.

command_pause.message: Pause or resume Lang Weave on this site

swap_description.description: Screen-reader description of a word shown in the target language: its English gloss, then the click action.

swap_show_language.description: Screen-reader description of a word flipped to English: the click action.

practice_cue_title.description: Tooltip of an English word marked for practice.

practice_cue_label.description: Screen-reader name of an English word marked for practice.

recall_label.description: Screen-reader name of the inline practice panel.

recall_prompt.description: Instruction at the top of the inline practice panel.

recall_dismiss.description: Button that closes the inline practice panel.

recall_cue_unavailable.message: Cue unavailable. Dismiss and try again.
recall_cue_unavailable.description: Inline practice status when it could not start.

recall_reveal.description: Button that shows the answer in the inline practice panel.

rating_known.description: Marks a word as already known instead of rating this recall.

recall_rating_failed.message: Rating was not saved. Try again or dismiss.
recall_rating_failed.description: Inline practice status when saving a rating failed.

recall_answer_failed.message: Answer unavailable. Try again or dismiss.
recall_answer_failed.description: Inline practice status when the answer could not be shown.

status_key_rejected.message: Gemini rejected this key. Paste a new one.
status_key_rejected.description: Model status when Gemini rejects the API key. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_key_isolation.message: This browser cannot keep the key private. Update Chrome to 140 or newer.
status_key_isolation.description: Model status when the browser cannot isolate the key. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_local_budget.description: Model status when the local daily call budget is used. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_daily_quota_later.message: Daily model quota reached. Try again later.
status_daily_quota_later.description: Model status for an exhausted daily quota without a retry time. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_daily_quota_retry.message: Daily model quota reached. Retry after $TIME$.
status_daily_quota_retry.description: Model status for an exhausted daily quota with a retry time. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_rate_limit_later.message: Model rate limit reached. Try again shortly.
status_rate_limit_later.description: Model status for a rate limit without a retry time. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_rate_limit_retry.message: Model rate limit reached. Retry after $TIME$.
status_rate_limit_retry.description: Model status for a rate limit with a retry time. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_overloaded_later.message: Model service is busy. Try again shortly.
status_overloaded_later.description: Model status when the service is overloaded, without a retry time. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_overloaded_retry.message: Model service is busy. Retry after $TIME$.
status_overloaded_retry.description: Model status when the service is overloaded, with a retry time. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_storage_failed.message: Local reading storage failed. Try again.
status_storage_failed.description: Model status when saving reading data failed. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

status_request_failed.message: Model request failed. Try again later.
status_request_failed.description: Model status for any other failed request. Fixed copy: never include provider or error text.

badge_new_text.description: Toolbar badge text when an update is waiting. At most 4 characters.

badge_new.message: New Lang Weave version available; reload the extension
badge_new.description: Badge tooltip when an update is waiting. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_working.description: Badge tooltip when the extension is active on this page. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_needs_setup.message: Finish setup in the welcome page
badge_needs_setup.description: Badge tooltip before setup is finished. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_needs_key.description: Badge tooltip when no API key is saved. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_key_rejected.message: Gemini rejected this key. Paste a new one.
badge_key_rejected.description: Badge tooltip when Gemini rejects the API key. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_needs_site.description: Badge tooltip when this site has not been allowed. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_paused.message: Lang Weave is paused; click to turn it on
badge_paused.description: Badge tooltip when the extension is paused. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_sensitive.message: Off on sensitive sites; click to turn on here
badge_sensitive.description: Badge tooltip on a sensitive site. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_site_off.message: Off on this site; click to turn it on
badge_site_off.description: Badge tooltip when this site is turned off. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_unavailable.message: Open Lang Weave to check this page
badge_unavailable.description: Badge tooltip when the page state is unknown. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_unsupported.message: Open a website to use Lang Weave
badge_unsupported.description: Badge tooltip on browser pages. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_local_budget.message: Daily model-call budget reached; review still works
badge_local_budget.description: Badge tooltip when the local daily call budget is used. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_model_error.message: Model request failed; review still works
badge_model_error.description: Badge tooltip after a failed model request. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_paused_until.description: Badge tooltip during a model cooldown with a known end. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

badge_reading_paused.message: Reading is paused; review still works
badge_reading_paused.description: Badge tooltip during a model cooldown without a known end. Toolbar badge tooltip; fixed copy.

popup_title.description: Toolbar popup: window title and heading. A product name; usually not translated.

popup_switch_on.description: Toolbar popup: visible label next to the master on/off switch when Lang Weave is on.

popup_switch_off.description: Toolbar popup: visible label next to the master on/off switch when Lang Weave is off.

popup_enabled_label.description: Toolbar popup: screen-reader name of the master on/off switch.

popup_this_site.description: Toolbar popup: initial label of the per-site switch before the page is known.

popup_not_a_website.message: This page is not a website
popup_not_a_website.description: Toolbar popup: label of the disabled per-site switch on a browser-internal page.

popup_turn_on_site.description: Toolbar popup: label of the per-site switch when the site is not yet on.

popup_on_for_site.description: Toolbar popup: label of the per-site switch when the site is on. Also its screen-reader name.

popup_practice.description: Toolbar popup: initial text of the main button, shown until the progress summary decides its label.

popup_budget_warning.message: The saved introduction date ($DATE$) is over seven days ahead of your local date. New introductions stay paused. Reset only today's introduction budget? Your reviews and progress stay saved.
popup_budget_warning.description: Toolbar popup: warning when the stored daily-introduction date is far in the future; asks whether to reset only the daily budget. $DATE$ is a calendar day.

popup_budget_reset.description: Toolbar popup: button that confirms resetting the daily new-word budget.

popup_budget_keep.description: Toolbar popup: button that dismisses the budget reset prompt and leaves new words paused.

popup_more.description: Toolbar popup: screen-reader name of the navigation with the Settings, My words and Help links.

popup_settings.description: Toolbar popup: link that opens the settings page.

popup_my_words.description: Toolbar popup: link that opens the page listing the learner's words.

popup_help.description: Toolbar popup: link to the online help.

popup_state_off.description: Toolbar popup: status line when Lang Weave is switched off.

popup_state_needs_setup.message: Finish setup in the welcome page
popup_state_needs_setup.description: Toolbar popup: status line before the first-run choices are made.

popup_state_needs_key.message: Add a Gemini key to start
popup_state_needs_key.description: Toolbar popup: status line when no Gemini API key is saved.

popup_state_site_off.description: Toolbar popup: status line when the current site is off or never allowed (for example webmail or banking).

popup_state_needs_site.description: Toolbar popup: status line when Chrome has not yet granted access to the current site.

popup_state_on.description: Toolbar popup: status line when everything is working.

popup_error_generic.description: Toolbar popup: error shown when an action fails without a specific reason.

popup_error_reload.message: Reload this page to start. Chrome blocks extensions on some pages.
popup_error_reload.description: Toolbar popup: error shown when Lang Weave cannot start on the open tab.

popup_error_budget_changed.message: Budget changed. Refresh and try again.
popup_error_budget_changed.description: Toolbar popup: error shown when the introduction budget changed before the reset was applied.
